flagship_project.name: Project FarmToCart-AI: Cold-Chain IoT Computer Vision QA, Automated Micro-Warehouse Robotics & Dynamic Spoilage Minimization
flagship_project.pillar: Cold-Chain Perishable Quality Automation & Automated Warehouse Fulfillment
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Grocery retail margins collapse on fresh produce spoilage and multi-temperature logistics. FarmToCart-AI deploys non-destructive optical fruit grading, real-time IoT temperature/humidity tracking from farm collection centers to doorstep, and automated inventory markdown engines.
flagship_project.tech_stack: Python / TensorFlow (Produce Computer Vision), Go (Fulfillment Services), MQTT / AWS IoT Greengrass (Cold-chain Sensors), ScyllaDB, Kafka, ElasticSearch
flagship_project.kpis: Spoilage loss reduced from 6.8% to 1.1%; automated produce grading throughput of 1,200 crates/hour; 99.9% fresh quality customer guarantee.
